Folks — thanks for the details. High level: yes, we can perform a scoped exclusion on our side that targets specific conversation identifiers, but we need the exact identifiers and the storage slice so we don't accidentally remove other records.

What we need from Valence to proceed safely:
- The exact conversation ID as shown in the Redwood UI (you included conv_3d9f — please confirm full id if truncated)
- The time window and timezone (you listed UTC; please confirm)
- Confirmation that this is limited to application-level conversation logs and not billing/usage aggregates (we will not alter billing records unless you explicitly request it)

Operational notes:
- Deletion will be recorded in an internal audit ticket and we can produce an attestation PDF once complete.
- For high-sensitivity content we recommend we perform the deletion in a maintenance window to avoid in-flight writes; expected downtime is none, but there will be a short write-lock on the storage slice (~2–5 minutes).

I've attached our internal data-deletion playbook (attachment) for transparency.

Marissa Cole
